verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an AI code review platform that ships a CLI and MCP tooling, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: the no-training-on-code policy, 'Strict data retention' as a plan feature, and self-hosted or air-gapped deployment options. None of these is a user-controllable switch for telemetry or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
